name: Diplomat’s Ring
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 1st; Slot ring; Price 5,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ornate ring is typically made of gold or platinum with one or more gemstones set within the band. The ring continually grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus on Diplomacy checks.

Additionally, upon command the ring will grant the wearer the use of comprehend languages up to 5 times per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells comprehend languages, Diplomacy 5 ranks, masterwork ring of at least 500 gp in value; Cost 2,750 gp

Identification DC 16
